start_frame: Low at the glass box, square-on: her hands and forearms heaving the heavy glass lid up, the very small cake below coming into view.
end_frame: The same square-on frame with the lid up and held: the words EAT ME beautifully marked in currants, sharp across their whole width, the cake reading as a tabletop at her size.
constraint_honoured: 'EAT ME gets exactly one clean legible read here; the currants are the only lettering in the shot.'
movement_note: Same discipline as the other two whitelisted lettering inserts: square-on, still, one clean read, no move to smear the currants.
